failure.message: the floor plan's scale cannot be established: no scale is stated by any reading that owes nothing to a scale. The scales its readings state are 0.005102 cm/px (0 independent, ruled out by the walls); 0.87747 cm/px (0 independent, plausible); 18.895522 cm/px (0 independent, ruled out by the walls); 0 printed readings contradict the one it was read at.
